name: ModelVariant792_HandleRequest
evidence: matching model_variant/variant792_entry.c: the image entry at base + 4 (two bolts launched at set times fly from a model point to the opposing slot, wrapped in sprite rings and Gouraud strips and trailing ribbons and smoke, then flare into a glow with ray fans and sparks while the light dims and recovers); for a non-negative request it selects the config record indexed by the request, seeds the bolt rings, puffs, rays and sparks and packs five texture images, otherwise it runs one frame and returns 0 before the start time, 4 once when the first bolt arrives, 1 once when the last bolt arrives, 2 after the last glow fades and 0 otherwise; Model_UpdateSlotControl calls the variant at base + 4 with the request modulo 1000 and then -1 (notes/model-structures.md)
notes: Shared name bound per image in *_symbols.txt instead of a #define remap; the same address in every bound image; the French header-809 and 906 images build it from the same source. HandleRequest names only the request dispatch, not the effect. See notes/overlays/model-variants.md#per-image-symbol-bindings.
